name: AI Learner
description: AI that learns any level (rapid learning, guides, replays, stats) and builds levels from a prompt.

training-speed.name: Training speed
training-speed.description: Game speed multiplier while the AI is learning.

rapid-speed.name: Rapid learning speed
rapid-speed.description: Game speed used while Learn Rapidly is on.

rapid-steps.name: Rapid steps per frame
rapid-steps.description: Game ticks simulated per drawn frame while Learn Rapidly is on. Higher is faster but heavier on the CPU.

smart-ai.name: Smart AI
smart-ai.description: Also learn from what's coming up (spikes, blocks), so skills carry over to other levels.

ai-provider.name: Level builder AI
ai-provider.description: Which AI the AI Level Builder uses. Without an API key for it, the free offline generator is used.

anthropic-api-key.name: API key (Claude)
anthropic-api-key.description: Optional. Lets the AI Level Builder use Claude. Leave empty to use the free offline generator. Stored on this device only.

claude-model.name: Claude model
claude-model.description: Model used by the AI Level Builder.

other-api-key.name: API key (Qwen / DeepSeek / OpenRouter / custom)
other-api-key.description: Key for the provider chosen above when it isn't Claude. Stored on this device only.

other-model.name: Model (Qwen / DeepSeek / OpenRouter / custom)
other-model.description: Leave empty for the default: qwen-plus, deepseek-chat or openrouter/auto. Examples: qwen-max, qwen-turbo.

custom-base-url.name: Custom API base URL
custom-base-url.description: Needed for Custom; optional override otherwise. Must accept OpenAI-style /chat/completions. Mainland-China Qwen: https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1
